plugin_desc: Advantech ICR/Conel cellular industrial router SNMP collection (enterprise PEN 30140, formerly Conel). Collects CPU utilization (statusCPUUsage, 0-100 percent), RAM utilization (statusRAMUsage) plus used/free/total RAM in bytes (statusRAMUsed/Free/Total), internal temperature (statusTemperature), and input supply voltage (statusVoltage). Temperature and voltage are omitted on ICR-2[0|4|5|6]xx platforms that do not expose those leaves. sysObjectID under 1.3.6.1.4.1.30140.1.* identifies ICR-32xx, ICR-323x, ICR-416x and related families. Interface traffic comes from the built-in IF-MIB table. This plugin does not share discovery or OIDs with switch_advantech (EKI industrial Ethernet switches, PEN 10297).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Advantech ICR/Conel cellular router (statusCPUUsage) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, cellular session churn, or abnormal traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports RAM utilization of the Advantech ICR/Conel cellular router (statusRAMUsage) as a 0-100 percentage. High memory usage may indicate leaks, oversized connection tables, or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports used RAM of the Advantech ICR/Conel cellular router in bytes (statusRAMUsed).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports free RAM of the Advantech ICR/Conel cellular router in bytes (statusRAMFree).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports total RAM of the Advantech ICR/Conel cellular router in bytes (statusRAMTotal).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Internal temperature of the Advantech ICR/Conel cellular router in degrees Celsius (statusTemperature). ICR-2[0|4|5|6]xx platforms do not expose this leaf, so the series is absent on those models rather than filled with a sentinel.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Input supply voltage of the Advantech ICR/Conel cellular router as reported by statusVoltage. ICR-2[0|4|5|6]xx platforms do not expose this leaf, so the series is absent on those models.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
